prompt: Describe a law on environmental protection
bullets: how you first learned about it
and explain how you feel about this law

notes.label: What
notes.text: Law on Environmental Protection 2020: sort waste at source from 2025; pay by volume

notes.label: How learned
notes.text: notice in the lift; economics and law class

notes.label: Who benefits
notes.text: everyone: landfills, recyclers, sanitation workers, future generations

notes.label: Feel
notes.text: in favour but frustrated: needs infrastructure + enforcement

part2.question: Describe a law on environmental protection

segments.v: I want to talk about the Law on Environmental Protection in Vietnam. This law says that from 2025, every family must separate their rubbish at home. They must put food waste, recyclable things and other rubbish in different bins. I learned about it from a notice in the lift of my building. My teacher also talked about it in class. I think everyone benefits from this law. There will be less rubbish in landfills and less pollution. Recycling companies can recycle more things. Workers who collect rubbish will be safer. I think this law is very good. But many people still don't follow it. In my building, some people put all rubbish in one bin. I think the government should check more strictly.
